title: Canonical finite derived evaluation of strict quotient point transport
statement: For D,l,E with l distinct from the characteristic, every complex P of completed integral sheaves and every n>=0, Q(u_n(P)) followed by the canonical strict quotient target isomorphism equals the canonical strict quotient source isomorphism followed by exact scalar restriction of frobeniusPointTransportFinite at Q(P_n). The strict map and the two isomorphisms are exactly those of [def-trf-point-transport-strict-quotient-models]; finite transport is the specified map of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. This comparison holds for arbitrary complexes, hence in particular for good constructible representatives.

proof.text: The natural finite sigma supplied by [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural] and the natural inverse-image comparison of [lem-weil-isomorphism-comparison-natural] give a natural transformation whose component at Q(K) is the specified complex formula. Conjugation by the localization representative isomorphism identifies its component at any derived object with the defined finite transport. At K, naturality of the exact sections and scalar-restriction factor isomorphisms, together with cancellation of inverse pairs, proves compatibility of the scalar-restricted chain formula and the two canonical comparisons. Specialize K to the ordinary reduction P_n.

theorem strictQuotientPointMap_derived (hl : l ≠ D.p) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P) ≫
        (strictQuotientPointTargetIso D l E n
          ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P)).hom =
      (strictQuotientPointSectionsIso D l E n
        ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P)).hom ≫
        (strictQuotientPointDerivedRestriction l E n).map
          (frobeniusPointTransportFinite D l hl E n
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P)))
